title: AM-GM for two variables
text:
Theorem 1 (AM-GM) For a, b \ge 0, \dfrac{a+b}{2} \ge \sqrt{ab}.







NoteSolution





Since (\sqrt a - \sqrt b)^2 \ge 0, expanding gives a + b \ge 2\sqrt{ab}. \square
